landing.hero.title: Free Group Scheduling Tool - Better Alternative to Doodle, Datumprikker & WhenIsGood
landing.hero.subtitle: Coordinate group availability the easy way. Mark when you're NOT available and instantly find the perfect dates for trips, meetings, parties, and events. No signup required for participants!
landing.howItWorks.title: How NotThisDate Works - Simple Group Scheduling in 3 Steps
landing.howItWorks.step1.title: 1. Create a Calendar
landing.howItWorks.step1.desc: Set up your date range and add participants. Share a simple link - no signups required for your group members.
landing.howItWorks.step2.title: 2. Mark Unavailable Dates
landing.howItWorks.step2.desc: Everyone marks when they CAN'T make it. It's faster than traditional availability polls - no more back-and-forth messaging.
landing.howItWorks.step3.title: 3. Find the Best Date
landing.howItWorks.step3.desc: Our visual availability heatmap instantly shows which dates work for everyone. Green means everyone's available!
landing.benefits.title: Why Choose NotThisDate Over Others?
landing.benefits.reverse.title: Reverse Scheduling Logic
landing.benefits.reverse.desc: Instead of marking when you're available, mark when you're NOT available. It's faster and more intuitive for group trip planning.
landing.benefits.noAccount.title: No Account Required
landing.benefits.noAccount.desc: Participants can submit their availability without creating an account. Just click the link and mark your dates.
landing.benefits.design.title: Clean, Modern Design
landing.benefits.design.desc: Beautiful Stripe-inspired interface that's easy to use on desktop and mobile devices.
landing.benefits.heatmap.title: Visual Heatmap
landing.benefits.heatmap.desc: Instantly see group availability with color-coded dates. Darker means more people are unavailable.
